scope: Curated, source-backed Chinese-language course evidence only; not the full crawl.
license_and_attribution: 复旦树洞/旦挞社区协议第4条默认文本许可为 CC BY 4.0；作者明确禁止转载、删除或限制传播的声明优先，相应原文不公开。引用须保留来源链接；未提供公开署名时注明“署名见原帖”。仓库代码许可不决定用户文本许可。
transformations: Only triaged records with explicit in-scope course codes are included; the full crawl candidate pool and private group material are excluded.
Author/account/user identifiers, email, phone, QQ, WeChat/VX, student numbers, share codes, signed URL parameters, and local paths are removed.
Markdown/HTML images and embedded base64 image data are omitted; no media is fetched or uploaded.
Deleted records, explicit no-repost requests, and apparent sensitive personal health/sexual/identity details are withheld as a whole body.
External Zhihu/Xiaohongshu sources retain metadata and canonical source URL only; no full text or images are republished.
Raw title/content fields derive from original platform response after redaction/withholding; triage summaries are not copied into raw content.
limitations: This is a redacted source extract, not a byte-identical platform response.
Course-code attribution and read/adoption fields are curation metadata, not source-authored text.
External full text, images, user profiles, private group material, and unconfirmed candidates are excluded.
Source pages may be edited or removed after export; URLs identify the cited source record where available.
